dvids.title: USS Canberra arrives in Colombo for Second Visit in 2026
dvids.desc: The Independence-variant littoral combat ship USS Canberra (LCS 30) arrived at Colombo, Sri Lanka, Oct. 26, 2026, for a scheduled logistics port call to strengthen relations with the Sri Lanka Navy and regional partners.

dvids.title: CENTCOM Commander Visits Strait of Hormuz during Milestone Week
dvids.desc: STRAIT OF HORMUZ — The commander of U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) visited the Strait of Hormuz, Oct. 25, as U.S. forces reach the milestone of assisting Gulf partners in exporting more than 1.5 billion barrels of crude oil since summer.
